candidates.label: Accurate delay summary
candidates.headline: Launch delayed by high winds
candidates.summary: SpaceNews and Reuters report the orbital launch was delayed after high winds exceeded safety limits. SpaceNews says teams may try again tomorrow if conditions improve. Reuters reports no vehicle damage.
candidates.whyItMatters: Schedule slips can cascade into later mission windows for orbital deployments.

candidates.whyItMatters: Exposed VPN gateways are high-value targets; delayed patching increases compromise risk.
